thread:
maria: Heads up — our audit export to SIEM shows a bunch of tenant-level gaps in today's EOD batch. Several tenants missing events (partition 0/3 delivered). Anyone else seeing this? :confused:

raj: Seeing same. I noticed manifest blobs list different partition_key than the forwarder expects (we index by tenant_id but the export uses org_id). Repro steps: download manifest, grep for partition_key, compare to tenant mapping.

kevin: Can you paste one manifest line? I'll check forwarder logs.

maria: here's an example blob entry: `s3://audit-exports/2026-03-17/part-00000.gz -> partition_key=org_42, tenant_id=null, keyid=alias/redwood-audit` — forwarder config uses `partition_key == tenant_<id>` in filter.

audit-forwarder-bot: ALERT: Forwarder rejected 122 blobs in batch 2026-03-17T23:00Z due to filter mismatch (rule: partition_key =~ ^tenant_). See /var/log/forwarder/forwarder.log: `Filtered out due to partition_key mismatch`.

sophie: That matches a recent ETL change — onboarding pipeline switched to org_id for multi-tenant IDs to support groups. Downstream forwarder config wasn't updated. We need a compatibility shim.

raj: Two practical options: 1) Update forwarder filter to accept both `tenant_` and `org_` prefixes (quick patch). 2) Launch a replay for the rejected blobs after normalizing partition_key (safer, needs KMS decrypt rights). Which do we prefer?

kevin: Quick patch + replay is safest. Patch to accept both prefixes so future batches flow, then reprocess today’s rejected blob list.

maria: On replay: note that replays will hit S3 -> forwarder -> SIEM path. We need KMS decrypt IAM policy for the replay service to read objects encrypted with alias/redwood-audit and alias/redwood-arch (some archived blobs are with different key). @sophie can you confirm who has key rotation admin rights?

sophie: I can grant the replay service decrypt for alias/redwood-audit. alias/redwood-arch is rotated monthly and currently only ops-hsm has access. Ops, can you grant temporary decrypt for replay window?

raj: Also check retention TTL: some events were expired by retention job at 00:10Z causing missing records for very late-arriving upstream batches. We should extend retention window for affected buckets to 72h while we finish the replay.

kevin: I'll open a quick PR for forwarder filter and a replay playbook. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/audit-forwarder/pull/482

maria: Thanks. Next actions: kevin -> PR + deploy patch; sophie -> KMS decrypt grant request to ops; raj -> generate rejected-blobs list and hand off to replay job; I'll coordinate communication to affected customers and SIEM contacts. :thumbsup:

audit-forwarder-bot: NOTE: Replay job queued (job-9981). Waiting on KMS grants and manifest list from raj.

sophie: Ops granted temp decrypt for alias/redwood-arch until 2026-03-20T06:00Z. I'll attach policy in case thread. Done.

maria: Great — keeping thread open until replay completes and SIEM confirms: please update when done.
